review_reference: Backend release backend-40684227016-1-fc43a6ab8b47c543 from production-backend-images run 40684227016 (D-Eminence/hid-system#127 at 80d3435, carrying #126's migration 0094; deployed 2026-10-28). That release deployed all twelve services at 80d3435, so every pin moves to it. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins: GET /api/v1/identity/me adds email, emailVerified, phone, phoneVerified and hasPhoto; new POST /api/v1/identity/me/contact-changes and POST .../{changeId}/verify (email change with a code, phone change with the password; CONTACT_UNCHANGED, CONTACT_UNAVAILABLE, CONTACT_CHANGE_STAFF_ACCOUNT, PATIENT_RECENT_RECOVERY_HOLD, CONTACT_CHANGE_RATE_LIMITED, CONTACT_CODE_UNDELIVERABLE); GET/PUT /api/v1/identity/me/profile-details (hospital and HMO, 409 on a stale version); GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/identity/me/photo (a body of at most 8,000 bytes at the edge); GET/PUT /api/v1/ehr/me/health-profile and the staff read of patient-reported health in direct care. This frontend (D-Eminence/health#27, merged as 0c77441) uses each where it is answered and keeps working without. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-10-28 (batch approval for this parity work).
